chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, forbade sexual intercourse while facing the qiblah or with one's back to it, and he forbade facing the qiblah while urinating or defecating.

key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the qiblah, the direction of prayer
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition in this legal context

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله forbid regarding the qiblah during intercourse and relieving oneself?
ai.summary: This hadith states rulings of etiquette and prohibition related to the qiblah. It forbids both engaging in sexual intercourse while facing or turning one's back to the qiblah, and facing the qiblah during urination or defecation.
